tunnel_ip.description: The server's address inside the tunnel, optionally /netmask (iodined's tunnel_ip[/netmask], e.g. 10.53.0.1/27) — a site value; iodined refuses to start without it.

topdomain.description: The DNS domain delegated to this server (iodined's topdomain, e.g. t.example.org) — a site value; iodined refuses to start without it.

password.description: Shared tunnel password (IODINED_PASSWORD, passed as -P) — a secret; the unit always passes -P, an empty one fails.

extra_args.description: Further iodined options before tunnel_ip, e.g. -c (no client IP check), -l <listen address>, -p <port>, -m <mtu> (iodined -h).
